why: Several 2025 papers prove restricted cases of the conjecture (Klingler-Tayou for varieties not defined over Q-bar, Daw-Orr for specific curves in Y(1)^n, Dogra for self-products of curves), narrowing the general open conjecture case by case.

found.title: The Zilber-Pink conjecture for varieties not defined over Q-bar
found.note: Preprint by Klingler and Tayou proving the conjecture for a class of mixed Shimura variety subvarieties not defined over the algebraic closure of Q; not read.

found.title: Zilber-Pink in a product of modular curves assuming multiplicative degeneration
found.note: Daw-Orr paper published in Duke Math Journal 2025 (originally posted 2022); proves a special case for curves in Y(1)^n; not read.

found.title: Some new cases of Zilber-Pink in Y(1)^3
found.note: Preprint by Daw, Orr, and Papas extending the special-case results; not read.

found.title: The Zilber-Pink conjecture for products of curves with highly degenerate reduction
found.note: Preprint proving another restricted case; not read.
